action_rules.supported: answer: the full question is supportable from required evidence groups; short paraphrased answer_fact required
action_rules.insufficient: qualified_answer when nearby sources support only a part and missing part must be explicitly withheld; abstain when no useful supported part exists. Neither counts as full-question sufficient.
action_rules.ambiguous: clarify: multiple materially different interpretations or missing required slots prevent a unique scoped answer; high source relevance is allowed

evidence_group_shape.answer_fact: short paraphrased source-bound answer, no copied quote

group_semantics: all groups required (AND); within each group any listed alternative chunk suffices (OR). Any-hit, all-source-groups-hit and all-chunk-groups-hit reported separately.
absence_scope: frozen-corpus support, not world truth; nearby packet alone cannot prove global absence. Root full-corpus witness checks and independent review before freeze. Unresolved labels replaced before results or marked not_evaluable, never inferred from test retrieval failure.

score_policy.primary_score: maximum finite trace.rank_score across technical items; empty technical result =>0; missing/malformed score=>error not zero
score_policy.name: max_technical_rrf_proxy
score_policy.ambiguous: excluded from primary binary AUROC/AUPRC/confusion; separate clarification slice, no low-relevance requirement
score_policy.threshold_selection: largest threshold with calibration supported TPR>=0.90 under score>=threshold; ties preserved. Test threshold never refit.
score_policy.gate_meaning: pre-registered diagnostic targets, not validated deployment safety guarantees; failure is a reportable result and never triggers hidden policy tuning
score_policy.auc: tie-aware ROC AUC; average precision for PR AUC with distinct-score tie groups; no Brier/ECE on RRF
score_policy.uncertainty: intent-cluster bootstrap with fixed seed, report group count and challenge prevalence

authoring_rules: calibration/test material and intent groups disjoint
language tiers alternate 38/37 and 37/38 to reach exact totals
public text is newly authored query/rationale/paraphrased fact only; original source snippets stay private
